name: Cable EZ-Bar Curl
description: The cable EZ-bar curl attaches an EZ-curl bar to a low cable pulley and performs a bilateral curl. The cable maintains constant tension throughout the full arc — unlike free weight EZ-bar curls which go slack at the bottom — while the EZ-bar's angled grip reduces wrist stress. This combination provides constant tension with wrist-friendly positioning, making it a highly effective and comfortable hypertrophy exercise.

execution.starting_position: Attach an EZ-bar to the low cable pulley. Stand facing the cable machine. Grasp the EZ-bar with a semi-supinated grip. Arms extended toward the pulley.
execution.setup_instructions: Clip the EZ-bar to the low pulley carabiner. Stand one step back from the stack.
steps: Step 1: Begin with arms extended, EZ-bar at thigh level, cable taut.
Step 2: Curl the bar upward by flexing the elbows, maintaining semi-supinated grip.
Step 3: Curl to maximum elbow flexion.
Step 4: Return slowly to the starting position.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale on the curl, inhale on the return.
safety_considerations: Ensure the EZ-bar attachment is secure before beginning
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full extension to full flexion with constant cable tension throughout.
coaching_cues: Feel the tension at the bottom
